claim: RDS Blue/Green Deployments let you make changes to an Aurora DB cluster in a staging environment, test them without affecting the production DB cluster, and promote the staging environment to production with minimal downtime; the document history lists this on November 27, 2022.
question: What do RDS Blue/Green Deployments let you do for an Aurora DB cluster?

values.display: promote the staging environment to be the new production environment, with minimal downtime

qualifiers.condition: Aurora PostgreSQL support was added on October 26, 2023

note: Chapter 26 owns RDS blue/green basics; this is the Aurora history entry.
